leftColumn.title: Moving Average Envelopes
leftColumn.subtitle: Fixed Percentage Channels
bullets: Bands set at fixed distance (e.g. ±3% or ±5%)

Major flaw: Cannot adjust to sudden market volatility

rightColumn.title: Bollinger Bands
rightColumn.subtitle: Dynamic Volatility Standard Deviations
bullets: Middle line: 20-day Simple Moving Average
Bands placed at ±2 Standard Deviations (2σ)
Automatically expands in turmoil, contracts in calm

ui_state.heading: Today's thread
steps: Percentage Envelopes use fixed bands; Bollinger Bands dynamically adapt using 2σ
In trading ranges, Bollinger Bands provide reliable overbought/oversold targets
In runaway trends, prices walk the outer band—touching it is NOT an auto-sell
Bollinger Band Width contraction ('The Squeeze') warns of impending volatility explosion
Fibonacci MAs (8, 13, 21, 55, 89) align periods with organic market cycles
Donchian's 4-Week Rule serves as the time-tested foundation of mechanical trend following
Over-optimization leads to curve-fitting; past perfection guarantees live failure
Kaufman's KAMA dynamically speeds up during trends and halts flat during sideways chop
ui_state.bottomTakeaway: Fixed indicators break under changing markets; adaptive volatility bands and robust mechanical rules endure.
